ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution with approximately 95 percent low-intensity dark pixels and 5 percent high-intensity white localized pixel clusters across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark ground with high-contrast white circular rosettes distributed globally; a concentrated white geometric patch is visible at the distal terminus of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree aperture and a deep bounding-box penetration at the central lobe convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the continuous trailing boundary; pixel-level peaks and valleys are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the leading edge transition; trailing edge exhibits a compound curve consisting of a distal concavity transitioning to a proximal convexity near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density detection of roughly circular white rings concentrated in the mid-section of the left lobe and scattered across the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned linear white pixel streaks detected on the lower quadrant of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular rosette scarring globally distributed; white pigment/scarring at the right distal tip; diagonal linear rake marks on the lower right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced contrast between the stark white circular rosette patterns and the uniform dark pigmentation of the fluke surface.
